mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 PM, here is today's balanced dish. Skies are clear over Verona Community Park under a Third Quarter moon, and the temperature is 63 degrees. Tonight will be cool with an overnight low of 46 degrees and no rain expected.

October has been proclaimed Community Planning Month to honor the expertise the Planning and Development Department brings to our city growth. Also, don't forget to look for letters regarding mandatory cross-connection control surveys to keep our water supply safe.

There is plenty to do, including the Farley Center Fall Festival today, the World Dairy Expo, and live music at both Bailey's Run and Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, you can also join a yoga session at Insight Wellness.
Regarding local activity, on September 14, a 21-year-old man was taken into custody after a pursuit following a report of retail theft in the 100 block of North Main Street.
Stop by Culver's to enjoy today's flavor, Andes Mint Avalanche, before they wrap up service at 10 PM tonight.
